description: The daemon page router (page-router.md): what each cmux page may call and which subscribe events it hears, and which v2 operation namespaces the daemon routes to an owner outside the operation catalog. The one source: the daemon embeds this file, and bindings/codegen/page_router.py generates the page clients' table from it.

home-channels.description: Channels (Home). It reads conversations through the raw conversation commands of its authenticated WebSocket, and the participants' pictures with participant.avatar.get. Its Cmd-K palette ranks the rows it sends with palette.rank (stateless: the rows go in, their ranked order comes out). A web link the person clicks in the Chief chat opens on the right side of the home workspace with workspace.open_url, only on the person's gesture (a host confirmation on the page relay); its WebSocket has no confirmation, so it is refused there. It manages the person's Chiefs (chief-profile-ws-v1): it lists and reads them and changes display_name, role and the avatar; create, delete, undo, instructions, personality, the lock and the grant (tools, harnesses, engine, self_edit) need the person's gesture; it reads a Chief's kept revisions (chief.profile.history). Its WebSocket keeps its raw subscribe; a page relay of this page gets no event stream. With chief-work-v1 its authenticated owner WebSocket may read chief-work: Chief-owned subagents and harness background commands on the configured Chief machine, through the same owner-page admission as the Chief registry. No other page or paired device gains this read.

history.description: History. Reads the merged history; a delete needs the person's gesture (hq-99 rule on cmux#13742); it hears history-changed, so an open page re-reads when history changes.

stash.description: Stashed Tabs. Reads the stashes; importing OneTab text needs the person's gesture. Restore and delete run in the app (its native Undo toast and the pane a page reopens in), not through this relay. It hears stash-changed, so an open page shows a stash saved, restored or deleted elsewhere (a tab menu, the CLI, another window) without a reload.

apps.description: App Store. Reads the catalog and the installed-app panels (grants, logs, icons). Hide/Show and revoking a scope need the person's gesture (they never widen what an app may do); an install, uninstall, allowed scope or other change needs the person's confirmation on a native sheet (never a click alone: a change can turn off an app's sandbox). It hears apps-changed, so an open page shows an install, removal or instance change made elsewhere (the CLI, another window) without a reload.

agent.description: The agent pane, and in it the New Tab page (page id from cmux-page://cmux.agent). It asks the folder trust question of a chat on another machine (cx-1bhjj): it reads the folder's trust, and its answer needs the person's gesture. No other page reads folder trust: it tells a page which folders the person works in.

bookmarks.description: Bookmarks. Reads and searches one browser profile's bookmark tree; every edit (add, rename, move, delete, a dropped row) is one bookmarks.apply on the person's gesture; it hears bookmarks-changed, so an open page re-reads when any surface changes the tree.

tasks.description: Tasks. Reads the local Tasks owner's mirror (tasks.snapshot); creating, changing, moving, archiving or delegating a task needs the person's gesture (each is one click, drop or Return in the page); it hears tasks-changed, so an open page applies every commit made elsewhere (the CLI, an agent) without a re-read.

feed.description: Feed (plans/cmux-next/feed-page.md): the person's feed read from the daemon's feed client (feed-client-v1), in the Inbox tab and the right sidebar. It reads the view, items, the Reports basket and Find Work's GitHub lists; an answer, decline, read, archive, snooze or Mark All Read (feed.intent), a GitHub refresh and a report reply need the person's gesture. It hears feed-view-changed and feed-reports-changed, so an open page re-reads on each change without polling. Posting, withdrawing, the GitHub setting and the presence stay with the verified app connection.

apps.description: The App Store owner (the app supervisor's store; raw `apps-store {op, args}`). Unix socket and authenticated WebSocket connections; mutations need origin user.

agent_session.description: Folder trust of a chat of this machine (agent-session-trust, commands.md; cx-1bhjj): `agent_session.trust.get {surface, cwd}` answers acpmux's acp.trust.get, `agent_session.trust.set {surface, cwd, level, home_confirmed?}` records an answer (acp.trust.set). The tab must be an agent tab of this store; the machine kind gate and the home folder rule of agent-session-start apply, and a page never sends home_confirmed (it cannot prove the person chose the home folder first). Unix socket only (a WebSocket page gets agent_session.not_trusted); a set needs origin user. The call runs on the relay's connection (one relay connection per pane).

bookmarks.description: The bookmark tree of each browser profile in the home session (bookmarks-v1, server/bookmarks_routed.rs): list, children, search, the omnibar rank and the Netscape export as reads; apply (the bookmark ops in turn, each replay-keyed), import_html and import_source as mutations. Unix socket and authenticated WebSocket connections; mutations need origin user.

tasks.description: The local Tasks owner (`cmux-tasks serve`, plans/cmux-next/tasks.md section 5) over its Unix socket; the daemon relays and keeps no copy. `tasks.snapshot {}` answers the owner's subscribe snapshot as the local person sees it; `tasks.<verb>` runs owner op `task.<verb>` with the request's idempotency key and origin user and answers `{result, seq, replay}` (the op result, the owner's committed sequence after it, and whether the key had already applied). Owner events reach the page as `tasks-changed {change}`, and `tasks-changed {lost: true}` when the link ended. A missing owner is operation.failed with extra.code `tasks.owner_unreachable`; an owner refusal carries `tasks.<code>` (not_found, invalid, conflict, ...). Unix socket and authenticated WebSocket connections; mutations need origin user.

feed.description: The daemon's feed client (feed-client-v1, plans/cmux-next/feed-page.md section 2): the mirror of the person's FeedDO on the app's cloud lease, the in-memory integration owner (GitHub items, update cards), the GitHub poller and the acpmux Reports basket. Unix socket and authenticated WebSocket connections; mutations need origin user; feed.post, feed.withdraw, feed.github.configure and feed.presence.set need the verified app connection itself.
